details:
I think it would be a great addition to the functionality and usability of the SteamVR 2.0 binding system to allow users to choose which analog stick controls which radial menu. This would essentially allow a user to choose to control their left radial menu with their right analog stick, as well as the right radial menu with their left analog stick. It would also provide the opportunity for users to choose to bind the controls for both radial menus to just a single stick if they potentially had a broken/dead controller or just preference for one stick.

Having clear labeling for the right and left radial menu as well as the right and left analog stick would ideally mitigate most confusion for users when setting up bindings in the SteamVR binding menu, as well as having the control system auto-assign radial menu analog controls to flip with the movement and rotation settings (as they currently appear to do). This allows users to flip their analog stick settings and have their radial menu controls also flip, providing most users the expected behavior from the switch. Doing this would allow the option to manually change these settings for any user that may be seeking a bit more modularity to their analog stick binding settings. I also believe this negates the confusion for the vast majority of users and leaves the more complex settings to those that are genuinely seeking them out.
title: [1484] Ability to distinguish analog stick control for radial menus.
